description: This PHP source file defines the ConsoleExceptionListener class, which is an event listener for handling console command events, errors, and termination events within the Goteo application. It manages global options, logging, locking, and exception handling specific to console commands.

classes.name: ConsoleExceptionListener
classes.description: An event listener class for handling console command events, errors, and termination events, providing logging, locking, and email notification functionalities during command execution.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping console events to handler methods for subscription.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages using the command's logger if available, otherwise defaults to parent logging.

methods.name: onCommand
methods.description: Handles the command initiation event; sets up logging, locking, verbosity, and error email options.

methods.name: addGlobalOptions
methods.description: Adds global command-line options for logging errors via email and process locking.

methods.name: addGlobalOptionToSendErrorsByEmail
methods.description: Adds the option to enable sending error reports via email.

methods.name: addGlobalOptionsToLockProcesses
methods.description: Adds options to lock the process execution to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: enableVerboseCommand
methods.description: Enables verbose logging if the 'verbose' flag is set.

methods.name: enableNiceColorsIfLoggerIsPresent
methods.description: Configures log formatting with colors and email error handling if logger is present.

methods.name: onTerminate
methods.description: Handles cleanup after command execution, releases locks, and reports total execution time.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during command execution; logs errors and reports via email if configured.
